# Reduced motion honored

With prefers-reduced-motion set, the motion module jumps every tween to its end state and CSS animations are disabled globally — the tour still works, it just stops moving. Reduced motion composes with the speed axes rather than competing: the axes scale a duration, and reduced motion sets it to zero.
